why: Lint cycle 9 (docs/v3/cycles/lint-9.md, lint-9.1 to lint-9.5 P2, lint-9.6 to lint-9.8 P3). The cycle 8 fixes hold: the icon-set and markdown-table false alarms are silent, every lint-8 miss its row turned into a form is caught (13 earlier seeds, none lost), require-static-classes fires on a basalt primitive and is a managed id (W19, W19b fail doctor), and the playground, the 37 ejected primitives and 18 of this cycle's 21 valid-code marks are silent. The rest: the rival word net reads `markdown-escape` and `calendar-link`, a string escaper and a URL builder, as a Markdown renderer and a date picker, the third cycle the net reads a utility by its name (lint-9.1); it misses downshift's `useCombobox` and `useSelect`, as the part names are read whole (lint-9.2); a scheme fork in JS (`resolvedTheme === 'dark' ? … : …` from next-themes) passes dark-fork, and next-themes itself passes import-boundary although basalt's tokens key on `[data-theme]` and next-themes writes a `.dark` class (lint-9.3); the stylesheet value list's background clause, which lint-8.10 gave a `--basalt-selected` pointer for the brand, offers that selection colour for a status-tinted row (lint-9.4); and `for await` over `res.body.pipeThrough(new TextDecoderStream())`, inline or through a const, passes reader-loop (lint-9.5). Each seed and its line are in docs/v3/cycles/lint-9/fixtures/results.md; reproduce with `zsh docs/v3/cycles/lint-9/fixtures/run.sh $PWD /tmp/lint-cycle-9` after a package build.
what: The two rival-signature false alarms gone without a new except list, and the misses and message gaps of lint-9.2 to lint-9.8 caught, fixed or stated as known limits.

packages/basalt-ui/src/core/** (BasaltProvider's scheme is named by the message, not changed)

change: False alarms first. lint-9.1: rival-signature's by-word match reports only when the import binds a component (PascalCase) or a hook (`use*`), the shapes that render a rival part; a lower-case function import (`markdownEscape` from markdown-escape, `google` from calendar-link) is a utility and passes. Where that drops a true report the seeds hold (e.g. `{ marked }`), keep it by name, and say in the JSDoc which `except` entries the shape test made redundant; the two `pass` marks `import-boundary/rival-signature 6` and `8` in docs/v3/cycles/lint-9/fixtures/structure.c9.tsx.txt go silent and no earlier rival seed is lost. Messages: lint-9.4, the stylelint value list's background, border, outline and shadow clause names its fix by the value's role: a status colour or tint is Status, Lozenge, DeltaBadge or a Num tone (tw-off-law's words for `bg-warn-tint`); a chart colour belongs to a chart kind; only a brand tint points to `--basalt-selected` or a surface token. lint-9.8 (P3): platform-glyph's `Next:` says a platform test that picks no glyph (an installer, a platform build) is waived on its line with the reason. Misses, each with an invalid fixture block or a stated limit in the rule's JSDoc: each rival part's `names` reads a `use<Name>` hook as its name, and `useSelect` joins the combobox part, so downshift's `useCombobox` and `useSelect` report (lint-9.2); dark-fork reads a comparison of a theme value (`theme`, `resolvedTheme`, `colorScheme`, `scheme`) with `'dark'` or `'light'` that chooses a class, with its token fix, and import-boundary reads `next-themes` naming BasaltProvider's `scheme` (lint-9.3); reader-loop reads `for await` over a `.body.pipeThrough(…)` chain and over a `const` bound to one (lint-9.5). The P3s: live-static-stale-time reads any `staleTime` key inside a `liveQuery` argument, as liveQuery's dev assert (`src/data/live/live-query.ts`) throws on any, and resolves a top-level `const` (lint-9.6); media-query reads `navigator.userAgentData.mobile` (lint-9.7).
commits: fix: one commit per rule family in packages/basalt-ui (import, class, structure, stylelint). No app or example commit.
